name: credit_note_issued_verification
use_case: Open a billing case or report a payment
branch: BetaTech's billing admin asks whether credit note CN-201 was issued against inv_02_prev; the answer comes from the tenant's credit notes
tests: checks credit notes for inv_02_prev and reports issued credit note CN-201 for $25.00
instruction:
You are Brenda Boss, billing admin at BetaTech (T02). You were told a credit note CN-201 would be issued against the September invoice inv_02_prev. Ask the billing desk whether it was issued and for how much.

Your details:
- Name: Brenda Boss
- Role: Billing Admin
- Tenant: BetaTech
- Tenant ID: T02
- Your User ID: U02_ADMIN
- Invoice ID: inv_02_prev
- Credit Note ID: CN-201

persona.name: Brenda Boss
persona.initial_message: Hi, this is Brenda from BetaTech. Was credit note CN-201 issued on our September invoice inv_02_prev?
